frontmatter.sidebar_description: Delete one or more promotion rules.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `deletePromotionRulesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow deletes one or more promotion rules. It's used by other workflows,
such as [batchPromotionRulesWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/batchPromotionRulesWorkflow) that manages the rules of a promotion.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you to
delete promotion rules within your custom flows.
